cagents-cagents:lever:bd1c3c9d-d324-4c94.description: *THIS IS NOT A DATA ENGINEERING RELATED POSITION* Position Description: Your responsibilities as a Data Center Cx PM will include: Working with project teams at client sites to inspect, test, and troubleshoot data center/ building commissioning facilities and/ or equipment. This person is responsible for identifying and coordinating activities for commissioning and reporting. Electrical and/or Mechanical commissioning experience is required. Requirements include: Position Requirements: BS in an electrical, mechanical, engineering field or equivalent experience 5-10+ years or more of experience in commissioning and qualification in the Data Center industry, Leading large (minimum of 4 megawatts) projects/facilities. Comfort in the Construction industry (managing vendors, clients, subcontractors) is a plus. Experience with commissioning plans/test scripts, schedules, budgets, change orders and summary reports is desired. Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams with full commissioning responsibility is desired. Other Requirements: Excellent oral and written communication skills in English Able to travel domestically and internationally as required Able to work (paid) overtime Able to work in the US without sponsorship now or any time in the future. We provide commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, project management and consulting services related to operational readiness to FDA regulated and other mission critical industries. Are You Ready? Our approach is simple; we put the client’s interests first, we do not stop until it is right, and we will do whatever it takes to get there. We are committed to living our Foundational Principles, both professionally and personally: We act with integrity We serve each other We serve society We work for our future Benefits Our full-time positions offer competitive compensation and benefits which include: 24 days PTO and 5 sick days per year, health insurance at extremely low cost to employee, financial support for both internal and external professional education as well as 70% long term disability paid for by the company. CAI Operations DCx Managers will be exposed to cutting edge technologies in the Hyperscale and other spaces. You will have an opportunity to work with recognized subject matter experts allowing YOU to be a key player in bringing data technologies to market. As part of our company culture, we invest in YOUR future, and commit to hands on certifications as well as professional training. Our collaborative culture ensures that our customers benefit from exemplary work across our entire range of professional services. #LI-MV1 #MISSIONCRITICAL

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:c112163c-bf0.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO - Strategic & Operational Partner
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:c112163c-bf0.description: About the Role We are looking for a high-leverage Executive Assistant to act as a strategic right hand to our CEO. This is not a typical administrative position. Beyond handling calendar management and travel coordination in a fast-paced, chaotic environment, you will play an active role in driving operational efficiency. We need a clear-thinking, proactive problem solver who can jump right in without needing hand-holding. You will analyze data, build reports, identify operational gaps, and bring solutions to the table before issues arise. Key Responsibilities 1. Executive Operations & Gatekeeping Act as the primary point of contact and buffer for the CEO, managing internal and external communications with tact and judgment. Maintain complete situational awareness of the CEO’s priorities, deadlines, and ongoing projects. Manage complex, fluid calendars across multiple time zones, adjusting dynamically to continuous travel schedule changes. Handle seamless international travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics. 2. Data Analysis & Business Intelligence Gather data across departments to create clear, actionable executive reports, dashboards, and presentations. Continuously audit workflows and metrics to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and areas for process improvement. Conduct research and synthesize complex information into quick, digestible briefs for decision-making. 3. Financial & Administrative Support Assist with financial tracking, expense management, budget auditing, and financial reporting. Monitor key financial indicators and track cross-departmental deliverables to ensure projects remain on budget and on schedule. Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion. Requirements & Qualifications Turnkey Capability: Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief Of Staff, Business Operations Manager, or Strategic Coordinator. You can drop into a fast-moving environment on Day 1 without requiring extensive training. High IQ & Analytical Thinking: Exceptional logic and problem-solving ability. You don't just report data; you understand what the numbers mean and recommend action. Proactive & Autonomous: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and actively look for ways to lighten the CEO's operational load. Chaos Tolerance: High adaptability, mental resilience, and composure in fast-changing, high-pressure environments. Financial Literacy: Comfort with numbers, spreadsheets, financial statements, and basic business finance principles. Time Zone Agility: Willingness and technical setup to work asynchronously and align with the CEO’s shifting global schedule. Tech Savvy: Advanced proficiency in modern workspace tools (e.g., Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Excel/Google Sheets, project management platforms).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:38a0c437-b42f-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:38a0c437-b42f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Poland. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8e035de3-71e0-.title: Head of Legal & Compliance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8e035de3-71e0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Legal & Compliance based in Spain. This is a senior, hands-on legal and compliance leadership role within a fast-growing AI-powered B2B technology environment. You will own the legal framework surrounding data, AI-powered calling, privacy, telemarketing compliance, and enterprise customer requirements. The role is designed to be built from the ground up, giving you significant ownership over processes, policies, and risk frameworks. You will work directly with Product and Engineering, helping shape features and technical decisions rather than reviewing them only after development. You will also lead commercial negotiations and enterprise legal and security reviews, helping remove friction from strategic deals. The position requires strong judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate complex regulations into practical product requirements. It is an opportunity to establish a scalable legal and compliance function while becoming a trusted advisor across the business. Own the legal and compliance framework for AI-powered calling and dialer functionality, including TCPA requirements, consent, do-not-call obligations, call recording, and disclosures relating to AI-generated voice. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure compliance requirements are implemented directly within platform workflows, controls, and technical processes. Manage external specialist legal advisors, including a TCPA-focused firm, and determine which matters should be escalated externally versus handled internally. Lead the privacy program across applicable regulations, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging US state privacy requirements. Manage data-subject requests, opt-outs, data broker registration requirements, and other operational privacy processes. Own data sourcing and governance practices, including supplier diligence, lawful-basis assessments, legitimate interest assessments, DPIAs, and transfer impact assessments. Serve as the designated DPO and establish an effective approach to AI governance as new AI and agentic capabilities are introduced. Draft, review, and negotiate customer and vendor agreements, data processing agreements, and other commercial legal documentation. Lead enterprise security and privacy reviews, working to remove legal and compliance barriers that could delay or prevent strategic customer opportunities. Serve as a key legal contact for enterprise customers and their counsel, building confidence and helping facilitate successful commercial relationships. Participate directly in product and roadmap planning, identifying regulatory considerations early enough to influence product design and development. Translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical product and engineering requirements that teams can implement effectively. Assess emerging regulatory developments, distinguish material risks from overly cautious interpretations, and help the business move quickly while maintaining appropriate compliance standards. Build and scale legal and compliance processes from the ground up, establishing only the frameworks, controls, and documentation that create meaningful business value. Requirements 8+ years of combined law firm and in-house legal experience, with qualification to practice law in the United States. Deep, practical privacy experience, particularly with GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, including applying these frameworks to real products, data flows, and business operations. Strong experience advising Product and Engineering teams and participating directly in technical and product decision-making. Proven ability to establish or significantly develop a legal and compliance function in an early-stage or high-growth environment. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.title: Merchandise Team Lead
msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Food & Merchandise Team Lead is responsible for a location or collection of locations and their respective staff compliments. The Food & Merchandise Team Lead has a focus on merchandise display and sales, proper guest relations, and appropriate use and maintenance of facility equipment . This employee will be responsible for overall management of their location on event nights. What will you do? Conducting daily audits, monthly location inventory , processing of employee time sheets. Ensuring that guests receive outstanding guest service in our locations, and staff at locations adhere to high standards that have been set out by Madison Square Garden. Maintains a good understanding of our products and services as well as our systems and practices. Assists implementing of floor moves, merchandising and display maintenance along with ensuring that the cleanliness and upkeep of our locations is maintained at a high level . Reporting to management any issue from a Personnel, Maintenance, or Merchandise standpoint. Ensures the processing and replenishing of merchandise on the selling floor by participating in receiving and monitoring merchandise flow. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years supervisory experience in retail or sports merchandising. Must have previous experience in training, cash handling, equipment operation and management. Ability to process information/merchandise through the current computer register system (POS). Ability to communicate with all employees as well as guests. Must be able to operate and use all equipment necessary to run the respective merchandise store/stand. Ability to move or handle merchandise throughout the store. Special Requirements This position is part-time and scheduled on an event driven basis. Able to walk and stand during the entire shift. Lifting, pushing, pulling up to 25 lbs. Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, have split days off, work weekends and holidays in a 24 X 7 environment. #LI- Onsite Hourly Pay Range $27 — $27 USD At MSG, we recognize the importance of upskilling employees’ talents and strengths so they can drive their careers forward. We are proud to offer a robust set of tools and resources to help employees understand their interests and purpose, harness their talents and obtain the skills they need to reach the next step in their careers. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here. We value diversity and are looking for extraordinary employees of all backgrounds!
